elements.title: € 270.000 House 1+1 bedrooms Tramelo Bordeira Aljezur - excellent location (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleThe property comprises a house and outdoor area, with an approved plan for the completion of a house consisting of an open-plan living area with a kitchenette, a sitting room, a bathroom, a bedroom and a mezzanine. Situated in a peaceful area, this property enjoys an excellent location, just a few minutes from some of the most beautiful beaches on the Costa Vicentina, offering the perfect balance between the tranquillity of the countryside and proximity to the sea. An excellent opportunity for a permanent home, holiday home or investment. Translated with DeepL. com (free version)

elements.title: € 299.000 Building Commercial 3+1 bedrooms Aljezur - terrace, privileged location (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleLocated on Aljezur’s main street, this building is registered as a residential property, but its prime location also makes it suitable for commercial use. It is spread over two floors with separate entrances. The ground floor is currently used as an office and includes a bathroom. The upper floor has three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom. An external staircase leads up to a terrace. Fun fact: this building, constructed in 1913, was Aljezur’s first registered guesthouse, a true historical landmark of the town. Just a 10-minute drive away are some of the wildest and most unspoilt beaches on the Costa Vicentina, with golden sand, dramatic cliffs and hidden coves where nature takes centre stage. Praia da Amoreira is about 5 km from the house, and the neighbouring Praia da Arrifana and Monte Clérigo, favourites with surfers, are right next to it. This village offers all the essential amenities, including supermarkets, local cafés and restaurants, a health centre, a school, banks and a post office, as well as a medieval castle and charming cobbled streets. The lively towns of Sagres and Lagos are about 30 km away, and Faro Airport is approximately 125 km away. Perfect for those seeking an authentic experience surrounded by nature, away from the crowds, this house is a serene retreat where the Algarve reveals its most genuine and timeless side.

elements.title: € 890.000 Farm 3 bedrooms Bordeira Aljezur - furnished, alarm, equipped, terrace, fireplace, store room (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleProperty consisting of three bedrooms, two bathrooms, cozy living room, functional kitchen and fireplace. It is furnished and equipped with underfloor heating, alarm system and storage. Outside it has a well-kept garden area, terrace, pergola and dining area, ideal for leisure moments. The property also includes a small ruin with potential for reconstruction, offering an additional opportunity for valorization. This house was completely rebuilt by an interior architect, designed with a focus on comfort, simplicity and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a space where the rhythm of life becomes naturally calmer and more harmonious.

elements.title: € 345.000 House 1 bedrooms Bordeira Aljezur (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleThis house combines authentic Algarve charm with a modern, relaxed touch. Completely rebuilt, the property is spread over three floors connected by a stone staircase and features whitewashed interiors, custom-made wooden furniture and natural textiles that create a serene and bright atmosphere. With a bedroom, a bathroom and a living room, a fully equipped kitchen and a patio facing the street, it is the perfect refuge for those who appreciate the simplicity of village life. Here, time slows down and every detail invites you to relax. Just 10 minutes from the wild beaches of the Costa Vicentina, such as Praia da Bordeira and Carrapateira. Close to Aljezur and around 30 km from Sagres and Lagos, it offers the perfect balance between rural tranquility and easy access to the coast.

elements.title: € 840.000 Farm 2+1 bedrooms Perdigão Rogil Aljezur - electricity, equipped, terraces, water, air conditioning, kitchen, water hole, garden (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleProperty with a housing, located in the middle of nature, in a quiet and private zone, surrounded by pine trees and also many other tree species, as well as a garden. It is easily accessible, with private path, parking zone, terraces and pérgulas, providing various leisure zones. House in a position to be inhabited, with equipped kitchen, heating, air conditioning, electricity and water from the network and borehole. Possibility of expanding the construction area.

elements.title: € 650.000 Farm to rebuild 5 bedrooms Chaparral Bordeira Aljezur - cork oaks (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleProperty located in a Natural Park, about 2.3 km from Vale Figueiras Beach in Aljezur. With two ruins to rebuild, one of which has an approved architectural project for a 200 m² semi-detached house. This property benefits from an exceptional landscape setting, naturally attractive for its unique forest diversity – pine trees, cork oaks, arbutus trees, orchards and vegetable gardens. Property with diverse natural attractions, including a lake and/or potential for a tourism project.

elements.title: € 545.000 Farm Corte de Sobro Rogil Aljezur - electricity, water (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleLocated on the Vicentina coast, with a total area of 7.09 hectares, it includes an old housing, a natural lake, a pond, panoramic views of the sea and the saw, just 4.5 km from Rogil, 7 km from Aljezur and 8 km from the beach. Electricity and water supply network are available on site, ensuring all essential conditions for housing or project development. The existing house has an implementation area of 195.8sqm and a useful area of 140.31sqm. There is a possibility of renewing, expansion or construction of a rural tourism project up to 2000sqm. With great agricultural potential is an opportunity to create a quiet refuge, a sustainable project or a lucrative rural business, this property offers what you are looking for!

elements.title: € 550.000 Hotel Aljezur - laundry (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleLocated in a beautiful area with easy access, approximately 8 km from Aljezur, this property is ideal for a nature retreat. It has prior approval for the construction of a resort-style hotel with dispersed units, comprising: 20 buildings, of which 15 are accommodation units/houses with a total area of ​​675sqm (45sqm/unit); 3 buildings for staff accommodation with a total area of ​​120sqm; 1 building for common areas and services with 400sqm; 1 building for laundry, technical area and storage with 150sqm. The project also includes a biological swimming pool, solar park and parking. Areas can be adjusted according to a new plan. The property has a wide variety of trees. Water is supplied via the public network and a borehole, and electricity and telecommunications are located close to the property. It is approximately 15 minutes from the beaches of Vale dos Homens and Amoreira, a 40-minute drive from Palmares Golf Course and approximately 90 minutes by car from Faro Airport.

elements.title: € 2.500.000 Farm Casa Vicentina Odeceixe Aljezur - swimming pool, garden (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleCasa Vicentina -Tourism in Rural Space is a Charming Property. It has 3 distinct buildings, providing a welcoming and comfortable environment for guests. One of them consists of 4 T1 Apartments with Mezzanine, in the second we have 2 T1, the cafeteria and warehouse with laundry and finally the third building with 1 T1 and 6 Suites. The relaxing pool, strategically located in the center of the buildings , is easily accessible to guests. The well-maintained garden, along with the natural beauty, provides a peaceful environment to enjoy moments of leisure and rest. Water coming from the Borehole and the Irrigation Canal. Solar and Photovoltaic panels.

elements.title: € 2.100.000 Homestead to rebuild Moinho do Corisco Aljezur - cork oaks (Provenda)
elements.contents: SaleProperty located in a quiet area, with easy access through natural vegetation, pine trees and cork oaks. The Estate has harmonious landscapes - hills, valleys, plateaus - as well as a beautiful Natural Lake. There are 3 old houses (to be rebuilt), in different areas of the property. Come visit this Property and enjoy what nature offers us.
